_readme: 'My mod list' rules for converted mods (ConvertDataMod.py / the converter's Update read this file). Each rule becomes a checkbox in the converted mod's settings, OFF by default, and acts only when a mod in 'when' is enabled in D2RMM ('above': only when it comes before the converted mod). mods: converted mod ids it is for (none = all). earlier: table/string paths where the mods above keep their values. skip: regex patterns on file/table paths to leave out. switches: switch ids to turn off. props: item property codes taken off items. option: true = an Options checkbox for a part of the mod itself, ON by default, needs no 'when', and its actions apply when switched OFF. Rerun Update-D2RConvertedMod.ps1 after editing. Format: Tools\DiabloII\modlist-rules.example.json.

rules.name: Classless above: keep its skill and character changes
rules.description: Classless goes at the top and changes the skill, skill description, character and stat tables; this mod then only changes what Classless left alone in them.

rules.name: Necromancer V1.6 above: keep its Necromancer changes
rules.description: Necromancer V1.6 goes above the conversion (Best Of order) and changes Necromancer skills, missiles, summons and pet types; this mod then only changes what it left alone in those tables.

rules.name: Inventory 10x8: leave out this mod's inventory panel
rules.description: Inventory 10x8 changes the stock inventory panel; this mod's own inventory layouts and panel art would not fit its 10x8 grid. Stash and cube changes stay.

rules.name: Expanded Cube: leave out this mod's Horadric Cube panel
rules.description: Expanded Cube makes the cube bigger with its own panel; this mod's cube layouts and art would not fit it.
